strongest_angle: Examine how Josh Wander, co-founder of Miami-based investment firm 777 Partners, orchestrated a $500 million fraud scheme before pleading guilty in federal court.

key_facts.fact: Josh Wander, 45, co-founder of Miami-based investment firm 777 Partners, pleaded guilty in Manhattan federal court to wire fraud and securities fraud.
Federal prosecutors in the Southern District of New York stated the scheme bilked lenders and investors out of at least $500 million before the firm collapsed.
Josh Wander agreed to pay back $500 million in losses caused by the massive fraud scheme after entering his guilty plea.

numbers.label: Fraud losses agreed to pay back
